entry_points.title: Fingerprint compiler and blinded scorer calibration
entry_points.question: Which pilot steering coordinates are stable across story states, and can a blinded local model scorer reproduce the human measurements well enough to reduce future review burden?
entry_points.finding: Which pilot steering coordinates are stable across story states, and can a blinded local model scorer reproduce the human measurements well enough to reduce future review burden?

entry_points.title: Matched-state narrative steering vector pilot
entry_points.question: Can blinded ratings of continuations from matched narrative states recover a repeatable directional steering vector for each model, distinct from story and prompt effects?
entry_points.finding: One reviewer completed and locked all 48 blinded judgments before model identity was revealed. Mean confidence was modest (1.69–1.88 of 3), so the estimates remain pilot evidence rather than calibrated ground truth.
